jobs.title: Senior Product Associate
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join our Digital Channels Middleware Platforms team and transform ideas into platform\-first products that drive innovation, agility, and exceptional customer experiences.


As a Senior product associate in digital Channels Middleware Platforms team, you contribute to the team by leveraging your expertise in platform product management to build new and extend current platforms to deliver fast, accurate and relevant customer experience. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and play a crucial role in shaping the future of our platform\-first products and ongoing success with a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability.


**Job responsibilities**

* Partners with the Product Manager to identify new platform product opportunities that reflect the needs of our customers and the market through user research and discovery.
* Considers and plans for upstream and downstream implications of new platform product features on the overall product experience.
* Develops and maintains healthy forward\-looking backlog, publishes quarterly roadmaps and summary to ensure alignment with strategic goals and provide clear vision for product delivery
* Writes the requirements, epics, and user stories to support product development.
* Leads end\-to\-end product delivery processes including intake, dependency management, release management, product operationalization, delivery feasibility decision\-making, and product performance reporting, while escalating opportunities to improve efficiencies and functional coordination
* Work with engineering and architecture to drive solution design for capabilities and think platform / capability first while developing products
* Works with all cross functional stakeholders to ensure that timelines and dependencies are effectively managed, blockers and risks are surfaced at a timely manner while ensuring that the firm's controls, risks and compliance requirements are effectively managed
* Analyzes, tracks, and evaluates product and platform metrics and uses that to influence roadmap / backlog
* Create presentations and documentation, including product feature release updates. Communicate with senior leadership and promote product features to align with strategic goals.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 3\+ years of experience in product management (with experience in platform product management)
* Knowledge of the product development life cycle including discovery, solution design and iterative development / rollout strategy
* Proven track record of maintain and prioritizing backlogs
* Knowledge of data analytics and building backlogs in a data driven manner
* Proactive approach to work with the ability to work independently and across functional teams
* Excellent critical thinking, problem solving and analytical skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Flexible, adaptable to shifting priorities; able to manage multiple tasks and projects in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment. Customer focused with the ability to turn insights into action
* Proven stakeholder management skills working across product, technology, agility, design and data teams to develop robust and timely product delivery plans and execution mechanisms within an agile framework.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Proficient knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics
* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

JoVE is the world\-leading video platform for scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Harvard, MIT, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.  

  

**The Role**  

  

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer 3 to help lead the development of fast, well\-tested, and performant code for our web applications and modernizing our application stack. If you are the kind of engineer passionate about developing well\-built, reusable components following industry best practices, and love working in a collaborative environment with your product partners and dependency teams, then we want to talk to you.  

  

**Responsibilities**

  

* Collaborate with Designers, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to build and maintain the user experience, accessibility, and development feasibility of the website, applications, and supporting digital spaces.
* Design and implement innovative solutions for the presentation of data and content on our websites, mobile apps, and other platforms.
* Adhere to JoVE’s brand standards and convey it cohesively across the website, supporting digital spaces and third\-party platforms.
* Stay updated on the latest standards, changes, and web design and development trends.
* Contribute towards engineering excellence in areas like automated unit testing.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders on project design and implementation and other developers to maintain standards and create a reusable codebase
* Expected to be self\-motivated, needing little guidance on completing tasks on time and meeting expectations in terms of requirements
* Explain and “whiteboard” complex technical issues to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise
* Debug software components and identify code defects for remediation.
* Assist in automating deployments to development and other environments

  

**Requirements**  

* 7\+ years of experience building scalable, data\-driven backend systems and APIs.
* At least 2 years of experience in a technical leadership role, leading and mentoring engineering teams.
* Strong proficiency in server\-side programming (Node.js).
* Familiarity with frontend technologies \- React, JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS
* Strong understanding of system design, data architecture, and microservices or modular monoliths.
* Skilled in designing and implementing RESTful APIs and integrating with third\-party services and external SDKs.
* Experience with event\-driven systems, asynchronous processing, and message queues (Kafka, SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, etc.).

* Experience working in a Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CICD) model, including GitHub and CI pipeline automation tools
* Ability to triage and resolve incidents and lead incident investigations.

  

**Benefits**  

* A competitive compensation package.
* We are fully remote!
* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


The Digital \& Innovation group at USP is seeking a Product Manager who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.

**Description**
 Amazon's travel, events, and expense programmes serve employees at an unprecedented scale, with a mission to deliver an employee\-centric experience that lets them be more productive, while also helping to manage costs, safety, and sustainability. Today that experience is fragmented across too many systems, partners, and manual processes. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to own the product strategy that consolidates these into a unified platform, dramatically reducing cost\-to\-serve while delivering a self\-service experience employees prefer over the alternatives.
   

  

 You'll partner with engineering, science, and design teams alongside third\-party partners to deliver intelligent automation, personalized experiences, and modern customer service capabilities. AI\-powered intelligent personalization and automation are tools in your toolkit, not the job description itself. You should be energized by applying them to genuinely eliminate friction, not just modernize the wrapper around legacy processes. This requires someone who takes ownership of ambiguous problems, makes hard build\-vs\-buy calls, and delivers measurable results at pace.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product requirements for self\-service capabilities that reduce support contacts, eliminate manual work, and cut expense processing time.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI capabilities for knowledge orchestration, intelligent routing, and agentic automation, to deliver measurable product improvements.
* Collaborate with technical programme managers and engineering teams to translate product vision into high\-quality technical solutions
* Drive the product strategy for shifting from fragmented third\-party dependencies to first\-party platform ownership, informing build\-vs\-buy decisions that permanently restructure the cost base
* Lead and develop a team of product managers and analysts; hire bar\-raising talent
* Influence cross\-functional global teams across finance, HR, and workplace technology to resolve dependencies and deliver shared outcomes
* Partner with customer services teams to set new program\-level success metrics (adoption, cost\-to\-serve, customer satisfaction) and use data to drive prioritization
* Write compelling narratives, strategy documents, and business cases to contribute to executive alignment, investment, and cross\-organizational resourcing for transformation initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 Start with a backlog review with your team, sharpening acceptance criteria for a self\-service workflow that eliminates a manual handoff. Move to a design sprint with engineers where you're debating trade\-offs between two integration approaches and deciding which to prototype first. Progress with synthesizing customer feedback into a revised requirements doc, then pressure\-testing priorities with an existing third\-party partner. End the day with a quick check on adoption metrics from last month's release, turning what you learn into next sprint's input. You build first, then let the data tell you what to build next.

 Amazon Travel \& Events exists to make every business trip and event seamless, safe, and cost\-effective for over 500,000 employees across 64 countries. Our Technology \& Data Solutions team is the builder behind that mission, designing the platforms and data capabilities that let employees plan, book, and manage travel and events and expense re\-imbursements with as little effort as possible. * Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for helping define, prioritize, and drive the evolution of the enterprise data platform as a product. We are seeking an experienced, tech savvy Business Analyst with broad expertise in automation capabilities such as Artificial Intelligence (AI/ML), Intelligent Process Automation (IPA), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Process Mining and no\-code automation to join our Hyperautomation team. jobs.title: BI Visualization & Reporting Analyst I
jobs.description:
**Working with Us**  

Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high\-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.


Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us .


Summary
  

The Business Intelligence (BI) Visualization \& Reporting Analyst position is a specialized role that focuses on developing and delivering insightful and visually impactful dashboards, reports, and data visualizations. The BI Visualization \& Reporting Analyst collaborates with cross\-functional teams, gathers requirements, designs and develops visualizations, performs data analysis, and ensures accurate and timely reporting to support data\-driven decision\-making and drive business growth for BMS globally.
  

  

Role
  

• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather business requirements, understand key metrics and identify reporting and visualization needs


• Partner with senior analysts to design interactive and user\-friendly dashboards, reports and visualizations using BI tools


• Create visually appealing and informative visualizations that communicate complex data sets and insights to non\-technical stakeholders


• Perform data analysis to uncover patterns and insights that support strategic decision\-making and business performance optimization


• Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather and integrate data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity


• Partner with senior analysts to develop and maintain data visualization best practices, standards and guidelines to ensure consistency and usability across different reporting and dashboard projects


• Optimize data infrastructure and enhance data quality to support efficient data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes


• Stay updated with emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in data visualization, BI tools and reporting methodologies


• Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis and visualization to drive business growth, operational efficiency and improve data\-driven decision\-making processes
  

  

Skills
  

• Working knowledge of data visualization best practices, principles of effective design and user experience (UX) considerations.


• Experience with data analysis, interpretation and visualization to derive actionable insights from complex datasets


• Familiarity with data extraction, transformation and loading processes, data governance and data quality management


• Solid communication skills with the ability to translate complex data insights into meaningful and actionable recommendations for stakeholders


• Solid analytical and problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a cross\-functional team


• Familiarity with the biopharma industry a plus , including knowledge of relevant data sources and KPIs


• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
  

  

Experience
  

• We welcome a bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field such as Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline.


• Proven experience (typically 1 to 2 years) in a BI visualization through work or school projects


• Have a strong commitment to a career in technology with a passion for healthcare


• Proficiency in business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms


• Experience with data analysis, visualization and report development


• knowledge of data modeling, SQL, and data manipulation techniques.


• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and ETL processes.


*If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.*

Overview:

Enterprise Service Management (ESM) is a key foundational lever to achieve Financial Planning key priorities efficient and effective service delivery to PepsiCo businesses globally, for all sectors, with great user experience. This role is a key member of the team responsible for implementing the ESM solutions for Financial Planning (FP). To enable this purpose, ESM is implementing multiple technology platforms, including ServiceNow, as a service delivery platform across multiple business functions. The objective of the role is to support Global ESM lead in deploying ESM Frameworks, Knowledge Management (KM), foundational processes, Service performance management and Service portfolio management.


The Enterprise Service Management Business Analyst for Financial Planning is responsible for partnering with ESM Lead for FP to manage requirements related to ESM solutions for global FPT org. The role drives gathering service\-related requirements, partnering with ESM CoE (Center of Excellence) and IT teams to implement the requirements for the Financial Planning function.


The role will work with the FP ESM \& KM Lead to manage the ongoing continuous improvement of the service management process and solutions.


This role has 80% focus on ESM and 20% focus on KM.

  


Responsibilities:

As an ESM and KM Analyst your responsibilities would consist of:


ESM:

* Elicit, model, and maintain all requirements for implementation of service management solution(s) across Financial Planning function in GCC, and partner with the FP ESM \& KM Lead to prioritize.
* Support design, development, testing and implementation of enterprise service management solution on ServiceNow platform and provide input into a unified ande intuitive employee centric experience for FP teams
* Monitor ongoing backlog of service management requirements \& enhancements across FPT to ensure alignment with ESM program priorities.
* Work with FP ESM \& KM Lead, FP Service delivery teams, ESM CoE (Center of Excellence) team to ensure consistent implementation of ESM frameworks
* Support FP ESM \& KM Lead in change management related to launch and adoption of Service Management solutions across FP teams, as well as GCC customers, i.e., business teams
* Support ESM CoE Team and FP ESM \& KM Lead in planning future roadmap/ strategy for FP Service Management solution(s)
* Develop service management related documentation, including requirements backlog, standard process documentation, operating procedures
* Support Service performance metrics management and reporting
* Support FP ESM \& KM Lead in developing materials for stakeholder meetings




KM:

* Support end to end Knowledge Management program in the areas of KM system design, maintenance, document management and business critical knowledge retention.
* Support Service Now content management (4000\+ DTPs (Desktop Procedures) on Service Now), collaborate with Capability leads (sector leads) / team members to ensure right knowledge assets are made available to all FP users.
* Support Capability centric organization \- creation and standardization of knowledge. Drive content standards and exception processes. Ensure association/ mapping of knowledge articles to capabilities to help with standardization and process efficiencies.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Integration Ecosystem
jobs.description:
**About Enterpret**
-------------------



As the world moves to AI native applications, one element matters more than anything: the data. At Enterpret, we are unlocking the most impactful dataset for businesses, customer feedback. We centralize feedback across every source, like Twitter, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Intercom, community forums, surveys, and Gong calls, into a single context graph. On top of it we build an adaptive taxonomy for each customer and an agent platform that lets teams query, monitor, and act on customer intelligence wherever they work, whether that's inside Enterpret, in Slack, or in their own AI tools through our MCP server.



Our customers include companies like Canva, Notion, WisprFlow, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, Western Union, and several other Product Led Growth decacorns and F500 companies. We are backed by Kleiner Perkins, Peak XV Partners, and Unusual Ventures.



Our engineering culture is AI\-native from the ground up. Agents, LLMs, and applied ML are not a side project here, they are the core of how we build. We work at the edge of what is possible in agentic systems and push past it.


**About the Role**
------------------



Every record in Enterpret's context graph arrives through an integration. We ingest customer context from fifty plus sources, and from our customers' own systems through our ingestion API.



This surface decides how accurate, complete, and fresh everything downstream is. It has been engineering\-led so far. You will be the first product manager for the Integration Ecosystem, working with a dedicated engineering team and reporting into the product organization. You own two things: the experience of setting up and managing integrations, and the behavior of the system underneath.



You will think from first principles about how an enterprise's customer context should reach Enterpret, and build a cohesive ingestion layer on top of the integrations we already have.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* Run the fleet like a portfolio. Fifty integrations, each built on a platform whose APIs, data models, and conventions keep moving. You will prioritize by revenue impact and error frequency, put the hard calls in writing, and decide which platforms the ecosystem integrates with next.
* Own the system\-behavior metrics for ingestion: completeness, latency, and error rates. You will define them, instrument them, and be measured on them.
* Own the integration setup and management experience end to end: connecting a source, scoping exactly what gets ingested (filters, backfill windows, previews), and managing it over time.
* Define per\-integration error taxonomies, decide which failures customers see and which page our team, and ship proactive notifications so customers hear about issues from us first.
* Build agent\-first setup: an agent inspects the customer's source, proposes the right configuration, and the customer reviews and confirms. You decide where a form still earns its place.

**What It Takes**
-----------------


* Direct product ownership of integrations, connectors, data ingestion, or API products on technical B2B surfaces. You have carried them through real platform change, like API deprecations, auth migrations, and breaking version upgrades.
* Fluency in how platform APIs actually behave — auth flows, webhooks, rate limits, pagination, deprecation cycles — enough to hold your own in trade\-off debates with engineers.
* You have defined reliability and experience metrics where none existed, instrumented them, and moved them.
* Comfort operating AI\-first. Our default is that not using AI for a task is the choice that needs explaining.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


**In 3 months:** You own the problem inventory for the integration ecosystem, prioritized by revenue and error frequency. The highest\-usage integration has a complete error taxonomy, and it is the template the rest of the fleet follows. Baselines exist for completeness, latency, and error rates.


**In 6 months:** Setup is self\-serve for the majority of sources. Customers resolve the most common issues themselves, and notifications reach them before they notice a gap.


**In 12 months:** Every integration has a health standard and is measured against it. The fleet runs on a maintenance lifecycle with owned processes for API deprecations and source\-platform changes. New integrations launch to the standard by default, and customers cite the setup experience as a reason they trust the product.


**Why Enterpret?**
------------------


* **The problem:** Fifty platforms that keep moving, and an ingestion layer every downstream agent depends on. It is a hard systems problem and an open product canvas, and you would be its first product manager.
* **Growth:** Work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership at a Series\-B company, with a dedicated engineering team on your surface.
* **Benefits:** Competitive salary, equity, hybrid work, premium healthcare.

**What We Value**
-----------------



At Enterpret, we operate with a deep sense of ownership. We play for the team and do what it takes to win together. We care personally for our teammates while pushing each other with honest, actionable feedback. Above all, we approach everything with humility and a drive to keep learning and getting better.


**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------



We are an equal opportunity employer. We ensure that none of our employees or prospective employees receives less favourable treatment as a result of age, sex, disability, marital status, colour, race, religion or ethnic origin. Equally we aim to ensure that no such employee is disadvantaged by terms and conditions of employment which cannot be justified.

**Why LSP44?**



LSP44 is the AI\-native agent and API infrastructure company for logistics service providers \- the 3PLs, freight forwarders, and brokers who move the world's freight. Built on more than a decade of the largest logistics data graph and carrier network on Earth (280,000\+ carriers, 1\.5 billion shipments, 706 million carrier events processed daily), LSP44 gives LSPs the AI agents, carrier infrastructure, and developer capabilities to embed intelligence directly into their own products and workflows.



LSP44 isn't a startup chasing a market \- it's the original infrastructure project44 built starting in 2014, and nine of the world's ten largest logistics service providers already run on it. LSP44 launched profitable on day one, with its own sales, engineering, and product leadership, and a mandate to move at the speed of the LSPs it serves.



If you want to build technology that ships in days instead of quarters, that LSPs embed directly into how they operate, and that's grounded in more data and context than anyone else in the category \- we should talk.


**AI at LSP44**



Every LSP44 team member is expected to be an intelligent, hands\-on user of AI \- and for Product, that bar is even higher: the products you're defining are AI agents. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist, but we do expect everyone to identify where AI adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate its outputs critically, and govern it responsibly, in your own workflow and in the products you build.


**Overview**



We're looking for a Product Manager to help define and build LSP44's next generation of AI agent and API infrastructure, in close partnership with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. This is a hands\-on, builder role on a small, senior product team: you'll own product areas across the LSP44 agent portfolio \- spanning carrier procurement, rate \& quote, dispatch, exception recovery, visibility, documents, and freight audit \- working directly with forward\-deployed engineers and customers to turn deep operational knowledge of how 3PLs, freight forwarders, and brokers work into shipped product.


**What** **you'll** **own**



You'll define the strategy and roadmap for one or more areas of the LSP44 agent portfolio and technology, grounded in direct conversations with LSP customers and the realities of how logistics service providers operate, embed, and buy. You'll partner daily with Engineering \- including forward\-deployed engineers working on\-site with customers \- to translate operational context into requirements, and you'll carry those requirements through delivery: scoping, prioritizing, and keeping trade\-offs visible along the way.


**Key responsibilities**


* Define and own product strategy and roadmap for one or more LSP44 agent product lines and technology, in partnership with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Translate deep knowledge of LSP operations \- carrier procurement, dispatch, exception management, freight audit, and more \- into clear, prioritized product requirements
* Partner closely with forward\-deployed engineers embedded with LSP customers to surface real needs and validate solutions in production
* Write clear specs and PRDs, and drive execution across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, from definition through ship
* Ensure everything you build is designed to embed cleanly into a customer's own tech stack via API and SDK \- LSP44 products are built to be embedded, not adopted
* Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure new agent capabilities are field\-ready at launch


**Ideal background**


* Product management experience in logistics, supply chain, freight brokerage, TMS, or another operationally complex B2B/API\-first domain
* Comfortable operating in a lean, fast\-moving, 0\-to\-1 environment, partnering tightly with engineering rather than through hand\-offs
* Strong customer instinct \- able to run discovery independently and translate operator\-level detail into product direction
* Experience with API or developer\-facing products a plus


**Requirements \& Skills**


* Bachelor's degree in any discipline that has built your technical or analytical chops, from computer science to business
* 4\+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, logistics, or infrastructure/API products

**Job Description**
**Role: Product Manager, Intelligence
   

  

 Location: Bangalore, India**
**The Opportunity**
 MiQ is looking for a Product Manager to focus on enhancing our Intelligence offering in our global markets.
   

  

 Intelligence is a growing part of MiQ’s business and a rapidly expanding part of the Programmatic landscape, situated at the intersection of watching, browsing, and buying ads. The Product Manager will support in scaling MiQ’s Intelligence offering by researching, scoping and developing automated trading solutions, developing performance algorithms to improve MiQ’s cost position and KPI attainment, and developing planning and measurement products in partnership with MiQ’s Platform teams to surface timely and actionable insights to our media traders and customers.
   

  

 This role requires a good mix of internal team collaboration as well as stakeholder management. Unlike traditional product roles, this position demands significant technical prowess and AI building skills. We want a PM who doesn't just write requirements, but actively builds functional prototypes, scripts data flows, and collaborates symmetrically with our Data Science and Machine Learning teams to de\-risk engineering cycles and ship best\-in\-class features.
   

  

 You will work closely with MiQ’s Product Lead for Intelligence, our platform product teams, engineering, design/UX, and data science teams to develop a best\-in\-class capability to help brands plan, execute, and measure campaigns in conjunction with the rest of their media mix.
   

  

**Technical Stack \& Competencies Looked For**
 Product \& AI Strategy
   

  

 Technical Prowess \& Prototyping
   

  

 Frameworks \& Data Stack
   

  

 End\-to\-End AI/ML Lifecycle
   

  

 Rapid AI Prototyping (Python, Streamlit, Replit, Claude)
   

  

 OpenAI APIs, Gemini etc
   

  

 Roadmap \& Backlog Ownership
   

  

 Prompt Engineering \& Model Tuning
   

  

 SQL (Advanced querying)
   

  

 Data\-Driven Prioritization Roadmaps, Project plans, Sprint plans/grooming
   

  

 Jira, Confluence, Amplitude, Pyspark, MIRO
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Gain a deep understanding of client needs by meeting with customers and internal stakeholders, as well as global MiQ team heads to ensure global validity of roadmap additions
* Deliberate with technical teams on optimal solution approaches by understanding and analyzing the technical problem statements.
* Drive AI Discovery \& Prototyping: Independently build, test, and deploy low code or functional AI prototypes (using Python, LLMs, open\-source models) to validate product hypotheses before committing full engineering resources.
* Develop Performance Algorithms: Research and scope automated logic and algorithms to optimize platform efficiency, minimize processing costs, and improve system KPI attainment.
* Own Technical Specifications: Write highly detailed, technical PRDs outlining data models, API payloads, and fallback mechanisms for edge\-case model behaviors.

* Translate Data into UX: Partner with Product Designers to turn complex algorithmic data and backend insights into intuitive, user\-friendly customer dashboards.
* Scale Internationally: Coordinate with global commercial teams to understand diverse market nuances and synthesize them into a unified product roadmap.


**What impact will you create?**
 As a product manager in the Intelligence team, you will be working on cutting\-edge innovation in the connected TV, Social, Retail, Mobile space. You are at the forefront of creating a one\-of\-a\-kind Intelligence insights and planning
   

  

 platform that is based on the largest global data footprint. As the SPM in the group, you'll be coordinating across design, engineering and commercial teams to solve for the problems faced by traditional and modern planners
   

  

 through a unique data backed lens.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* The Experience: 4\+ years of product management experience owning data\-intensive, algorithmic, or AI/ML\-driven products.
* Technically Savvy: You have a background in Computer Science, Data Science, or equivalent technical experience. You are comfortable writing SQL queries and parsing system architecture diagrams.
* The "Builder" Mindset: You possess the coding/scripting skills required to call APIs, build basic prompt pipelines, and create internal tooling to demonstrate proof\-of\-concept features.
* Analytical Powerhouse: Highly analytical and data\-driven; comfortable navigating ambiguous datasets to uncover performance trends.
* Cultural Alignment:


 ○ Agility: You embrace change and adapt quickly to shifting technological landscapes.
   

  

 ○ Determination: You have a relentless "figure it out" mentality when solving complex technical hurdles.
   

  

 ○ Courage: You dare to challenge standard product paradigms and experiment with unconventional AI solutions

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Introduction**
 Plotline helps consumer apps create personalized in\-app and off\-app experiences without repeated engineering effort.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to own key product modules end\-to\-end. This is a
 **1\-to\-n product role** 
 focused on improving, scaling, and driving adoption of existing and new capabilities.
   

  

 You will work directly with customers, designers, engineers, Customer Success, and founders to decide what to build, ship it, and ensure customers receive measurable value from it.
   

  

****What You Will Own****
* Own the roadmap for assigned in\-app and off\-app modules
* Speak regularly with customers and participate in QBRs
* Identify recurring customer problems and convert them into scalable product improvements
* Benchmark Plotline against competitors and close important product gaps
* Define requirements and problem statements for design and engineering
* Drive features from prioritization through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Measure whether shipped features improve customer value
* Help establish Plotline as an innovative, AI\-first, class\-leading product


****What Success Looks Like****
**First 3 Months**
* Develop a strong understanding of Plotline’s customers, products, and competitive landscape
* Build relationships with 5 to 6 customers and independently run product conversations
* Establish adoption and value metrics for assigned modules
* Identify and prioritize the most important product gaps
* Own at least one meaningful product improvement from problem definition to launch


**First Year**
* Get each assigned module adopted by at least five paying customers
* Improve adoption and meaningful usage after launch
* Deliver improvements that solve recurring problems across multiple customers
* Keep Plotline competitive with leading customer\-engagement platforms
* Build a clear, evidence\-based roadmap with explicit trade\-offs
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in customer value, retention, or expansion


**Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership**
* Own assigned modules from roadmap through adoption and continuous improvement
* Prioritize customer problems using customer evidence, usage data, commercial impact, competitive context, and engineering effort
* Make clear decisions about what to build, what to delay, and what not to build
* Define the smallest valuable version and reduce unnecessary scope


**Customer Insight**
* Speak regularly with customers and independently lead product discussions
* Participate in QBRs and understand how customers use Plotline
* Synthesize customer interviews, support issues, usage data, and commercial feedback
* Separate recurring product problems from one\-off feature requests
* Validate whether shipped solutions have resolved the original problem


**Competitive Benchmarking**
* Regularly evaluate competing products and emerging market trends
* Identify capabilities where Plotline must match or lead the market
* Translate competitive findings into practical product decisions
* Help ensure Plotline is perceived as innovative and AI\-first


**Product Delivery**
* Give designers clear problems, user context, constraints, and desired outcomes
* Partner closely with engineering on feasibility, trade\-offs, edge cases, and delivery
* Maintain clear scope, requirements, success metrics, and non\-goals
* Resolve ambiguity and unblock decisions during development
* Coordinate launches with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Support


**Adoption and Outcomes**
* Define success metrics before development begins
* Create rollout, enablement, and adoption plans for every major launch
* Track customer adoption, repeat usage, customer value, and retention signals
* Investigate why valuable features are not being adopted
* Improve, reposition, or stop investing based on evidence


****What we are looking for****
* 3 to 6 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a comparable technology product
* Proven ownership of products or modules from prioritization through adoption
* Evidence of shipping and scaling features across multiple paying customers
* Strong examples of measurable adoption, usage, retention, or business impact
* Experience making prioritization decisions under limited engineering capacity
* Ability to independently run customer conversations
* Strong product judgment and customer empathy
* Experience working closely with product designers and engineers
* Comfort understanding APIs, SDKs, integrations, data flows, and analytics
* Strong written and verbal communication


****Strong Signals****
* You can explain what you personally decided, shipped, and improved
* You have taken a feature from low adoption to meaningful customer usage
* You have rejected attractive requests to protect a more important outcome
* You can identify patterns across conflicting customer feedback
* You benchmark competitors without blindly copying them
* You define success through customer outcomes, not launches
* You continue owning a product after it ships


****What This Role Is Not****
* It is not primarily a GTM, sales, or pipeline\-generation role
* It is not a project\-management or ticket\-writing role
* It is not limited to launching new features
* It is not a pure 0\-to\-1 discovery role
* It is not about building custom solutions for every customer


****Why Join Plotline?****
* Own strategically important products used by consumer businesses globally
* Work directly with customers, founders, designers, and engineers
* Shape the roadmap across in\-app engagement, off\-app communication, analytics, gamification, and AI
* See your work move from customer problem to shipped product and measurable adoption
* Operate with meaningful autonomy and clear outcome ownership


 If you enjoy understanding customers, making difficult product decisions, shipping with strong teams, and ensuring products create real value after launch, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
**About BiteSpeed**




  





 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.** 




  





 We're currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
 



  





 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!** 




  





**Check out more about us here** 
 \- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
 



  





 We've had some solid investors back us (making it easier for you to stalk us since you'd do this anyway).
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 Enterprise customers rarely come to us with neatly packaged problems. They come with a business goal, a messy process, a bunch of systems that don't talk to each other and a question:
 **"Can AI solve this?"** 




  





 We’re looking for an
 **AI Product Manager** 
 who can sit with our enterprise customers, understand these problems deeply and turn them into
 **AI\-powered solutions** 
 . You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and customer conversations, working closely with our product and engineering teams to take solutions from an idea to something that actually works.
 



  





 This isn't a traditional PM role where you'll spend your days writing PRDs and moving tickets around. You'll be expected to get into the weeds, understand how things work, figure out what can be automated or solved with AI, and work backwards from the business outcome. You’ll have a front\-row seat to some of the most interesting AI use cases emerging in commerce.
 



  





**What you'll do**



* Work directly with
 **enterprise customers** 
 to understand their business processes, pain points and goals, and identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful impact.



  




* Translate ambiguous business problems into
 **AI\-led solution strategies** 
 , figuring out what should be automated, augmented or redesigned.



  




* Own the solutioning process from
 **problem discovery to implementation** 
 , working closely with engineering, product and customer\-facing teams.



  




* Design workflows and solutions using
 **LLMs, AI agents, automation and BiteSpeed's product capabilities** 
 to solve real customer problems.



  




* Work with enterprise stakeholders to build business cases, define success metrics and communicate the expected impact of proposed solutions.



  




* Get hands\-on with the details when required, whether that's understanding APIs, data flows, system architecture or experimenting with AI tools and prototypes.



  




* Identify patterns across customer problems and feed those insights back into the
 **product roadmap** 
 , helping us decide what should become a scalable product rather than a one\-off solution.



  




* Build repeatable
 **solutioning playbooks, processes and operating mechanisms** 
 that help us solve enterprise problems faster as we scale.



  




* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic accounts, helping them win, onboard and grow enterprise customers through better technical and AI\-led solutioning.



  




* Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and continuously experiment with new models, tools and approaches that could unlock better solutions for our customers.



  





**What makes you a good fit**




  




* You enjoy sitting with a messy problem and figuring out
 **"how would we actually solve this?"** 
 rather than waiting for someone to hand you a requirements document.



  




* You have a
 **strong technical foundation** 
 and are comfortable understanding APIs, integrations, data flows and software systems. You don't necessarily need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be technical enough to go deep when the problem demands it.



  




* You have
 **3\+ years of experience** 
 in product, solutions engineering, consulting, technology, strategy \& operations or a similar role where you've solved complex business problems.



  




* You are genuinely curious about
 **AI and LLMs** 
 and have experimented with AI tools, agents, workflows or applications beyond simply using ChatGPT to write emails.



  




* You are comfortable speaking to
 **enterprise customers and senior stakeholders** 
 , understanding their problems and explaining technical solutions in simple business language.



  




* You have strong business judgment and can distinguish between a problem that needs a fancy AI solution and one that just needs a better process.



  




* You are comfortable operating with
 **ambiguity and high ownership** 
 . There won't always be a playbook, and that's kind of the point.



  




* You care about outcomes more than job titles and enjoy moving between strategy, customer conversations and getting your hands dirty with execution.



  





**Salary and Location**




  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team
 



  





**Our Way Of Life**
 \- https://www.notion.so/bitespeed/Way\-Of\-Life\-At\-BiteSpeed\-44d9b9614d9641419da910189b1e9f8e.

jobs.description:
**About Eloelo Group** 




 Eloelo Group is one of India's fastest\-growing consumer technology companies, building category\-defining products at the intersection of content, technology, and culture. The Group's flagship products —
 **Story TV** 
 in micro\-drama and
 **Master** 
 in micro\-learning — have together placed two Eloelo apps in India's Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short\-form vertical content every day.
 



  





 Story TV is India's leading micro\-drama platform, with 10M\+ users and 500\+ original titles produced in partnership with studios like Balaji Telefilms and Applause Entertainment. Master is India's \#1 micro\-learning app, scaling to 5M\+ users in 50 days with 1,000\+ bite\-sized courses across AI, finance, English, and life skills.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 As a Product Manager at Story TV, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for one or more key product areas — ranging from content discovery and recommendation systems to creator dashboards, live streaming experiences, or monetisation features. You will work at the intersection of user research, data, design, and engineering to build products that millions of viewers and creators love. This is a high\-ownership, high\-impact role for someone who is deeply user\-obsessed, data\-informed, and execution\-ready.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Product Strategy \& Roadmap** 



* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your designated product area in alignment with Story TV's business goals.
* Identify opportunities through user research, data analysis, competitive benchmarking, and stakeholder inputs.
* Prioritise features and initiatives using structured frameworks (RICE, ICE, MoSCoW) to maximise impact.



  





**Discovery \& User Research** 



* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to deeply understand user needs, pain points, and behaviours.
* Synthesise insights into clear problem statements and translate them into well\-defined product requirements.
* Continuously validate assumptions through A/B testing, user interviews, usability testing, and analytics.



  





**Execution \& Delivery** 



* Write crisp PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable the engineering and design teams to build effectively.
* Partner with engineering leads to scope, plan, and deliver features on time with high quality.
* Own the sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management processes for your pod.



  





**Data, Metrics \& Growth** 



* Define and track key product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, watch time, engagement rate, conversion) and own performance dashboards.
* Use data to drive product decisions, identify growth levers, and course\-correct where needed.
* Drive experimentation culture — design, launch, and analyse A/B tests to optimise product experiences.



  





**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Business teams to deliver cohesive product experiences.
* Communicate product plans, progress, and results clearly to leadership and cross\-functional partners.
* Act as the voice of the user within the team and consistently advocate for user\-centric decisions.



 What We're Looking For
 



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 5–7 years of product management experience, preferably in a consumer internet, OTT, media, or entertainment product.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with SQL, product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, or similar), and deriving actionable insights from data.
* Experience writing detailed PRDs and working in agile development environments.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills — ability to present complex ideas simply and persuasively.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to self\-manage and deliver in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Prior experience with video streaming platforms, OTT products, content recommendation systems, or creator economy tools.
* Exposure to personalisation, ML\-driven features, or recommendation algorithms is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with monetisation models — AVOD, SVOD, in\-app purchases, or creator revenue sharing.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA from a premier institution is a plus.
* Experience working in a high\-growth startup environment.



  





 Traits That Will Make You Exceptional
 


* You are deeply curious about what users want and even more curious about why.
* You treat data as a compass, not a crutch — you know when to trust the numbers and when to trust your instincts.
* You are a strong communicator who can inspire a team around a vision and also get into the weeds with engineers when needed.
* You move fast without breaking things — you know how to ship iteratively and learn quickly.
* You are passionate about storytelling, content, and the future of entertainment in India.



  





 What We Offer
 


* An opportunity to shape the product experience of a rapidly growing digital entertainment platform.
* A collaborative, creative, and fast\-moving work environment with passionate colleagues.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-linked bonuses, and ESOPs.
* Direct access to leadership and a culture that values product thinking at every level.
* Significant career growth opportunities as Story TV scales its audience and product portfolio.



  





 How to Apply
 



 Excited about this opportunity? Send your resume along with a short note on a product you admire and why to our HR team. We'd love to understand how you think about products.

 Kuku is India's one of the largest content platforms. This role owns the Engagement charter at Kuku — the cross\-functional function responsible for how often people come back, how deep they go, and how the product turns a first listen into a daily habit. You'll run the POD's roadmap end to end: dig into user behaviour, decide what to build next, and ship features that move engagement and retention. It's a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a cohort chart and in a prototype, and who can turn a hunch into something clickable before writing a single line of spec.
   

  

**What You'll Work OnOwn The Engagement POD**
* Own the engagement roadmap end to end — set the direction for the POD, decide what gets built, and drive it from idea to launch to iteration.
* Run the POD's day\-to\-day: define and prioritise the backlog, keep engineering and design unblocked, and make the calls that keep the squad moving.
* Own engagement and retention metrics for the POD, and be accountable for the number, not just the shipping.


**User Analysis \& Insight**
* Do the user analysis yourself — cohort, funnel, and retention analysis to understand where people drop off and why they come back.
* Combine quantitative data with qualitative research (user interviews, session reviews, feedback) to build a real picture of listener behaviour.
* Turn insight into a clear, prioritised view of what to build next.


**Feature Planning \& Prototyping**
* Plan new features from problem to spec — define the opportunity, size it, write crisp requirements, and align the POD around them.
* Vibe code your ideas. Use AI\-assisted coding and prototyping tools to build quick, working prototypes and clickable demos, so ideas get validated with real interaction before they hit the roadmap.
* Design and run experiments (A/B tests) to validate whether a feature actually moves the needle.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Communicate what you're building and why, and keep stakeholders aligned on outcomes over output.


**What We're Looking For**
* 3–6 years in product management, ideally on consumer products at real scale.

**Preferred Tools \& Technologies**

* Prototyping / Vibe coding: Claude, Cursor, v0, Figma
* Experimentation: A/B testing and feature\-flag tooling


**Education**
* Bachelor's or Master's in any discipline — or equivalent practical experience. What matters is judgement, curiosity, and a bias for shipping.


**What We Offer**
* Full ownership of a POD that directly moves the numbers that matter.
* Competitive comp \+ ESOPs.
* Learning budget and certification support.
* A team that cares about outcomes, not just output.

KUKU aims to be India’s largest cultural exporter of stories, culture, and history to the world with a firm belief in “Create In India, Create For The World”.

With a mission to provide high\-quality, personalized stories across genres from entertainment across multiple formats and languages, KUKU continues to push boundaries and redefine India’s entertainment industry.

 Merge serves fintechs, investment platforms, marketplaces, and corporate treasury teams globally.

 At Merge, we are driven by innovation and a commitment to excellence in the fintech space. As a Product Manager, you will be crucial in executing product strategies that align with our company’s mission to revolutionize global banking and payments. Our team values include customer focus, meticulous craftsmanship, relentless curiosity and innovation. We are looking for a dynamic problem solver who thrives on new challenges, has a passion for launching fintech products and can effectively communicate across all levels of the organization.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.


Come make an impact every day at Zebra.


**What We're Looking For:**

In this rapidly evolving world, Zebra Technologies is always looking for new ways to disrupt the status quo, go to market faster, and optimize customer experiences. We are seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Product Owner to help lead this mission. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the success of a project in Scrum. The product owner is responsible for managing and optimizing the product backlog in order to maximize the value of the product and ensure product vision is met. We need someone who has an entrepreneurial mindset for distilling business value and goals into roadmaps and refined product backlogs. Most important, we need a product owner who can help us build better products that people love to use.
**Objectives of this role**

* Lead team scrums to define product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities, effectively communicating with stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.
* Develop a deep understanding of Zebra's products, competitive landscape, and customer needs to align the product roadmap with strategic business goals.
* Work closely with product managers and business teams to create and maintain the product backlog according to business value, ROI, and customer impact.
* Act as a highly collaborative bridge between engineering teams and business stakeholders, ensuring seamless alignment on requirements, timelines, and technical constraints.

**Responsibilities**

Role Overview:


We have an exciting opportunity for someone to join us as an *AI Enablement Analyst within the Coffee division, based in Bangalore, India****,*** *and* to work in a truly global environment.


Based in Bangalore within Volcafe’s Supply Chain Global Business Services group, the AI Enablement Analyst helps optimise the day\-to\-day tasks of the group and streamline the physical coffee supply chain from origin to the end customer. The role centres on the end\-to\-end flow of green coffee – origination, contract execution, shipment and logistics, inventory, quality, documentation, certification, invoicing, and settlement – finding where the process can be streamlined leveraging technology and AI. The role follows Bangalore business hours, aligned with global handoff needs.


Working hand in hand with cross\-functional teams and colleagues around the globe – origin, operations, logistics, trade, finance, quality, and compliance – the analyst maps how coffee actually moves and where friction, duplication, and manual effort slow it down. They turn those insights into clearer workflows, better data, and practical improvements that raise speed, control, and visibility across the supply chain lifecycle, and that hand off cleanly between regions and global teams.


AI and automation are core enablers rather than the objective. Every recurring manual task is challenged, with the analyst applying AI, automation, and analytics to remove low\-value effort so the team can focus on exceptions, judgement, and decisions. This is a hands\-on, operations\-close role for someone who understands the how supply chains operate and is comfortable getting into operational details.


The role provides long term development potential for someone eager to demonstrate their skills and experience in the fast\-paced soft commodities environment

**Volcafe Ltd** is one of the world’s leading international green coffee trading companies, operating in over 20 countries globally. Our expertise spans green coffee procurement and preparation, sustainability, blending, quality control, risk management and export as well as importing and distribution. We are part of **ED\&F Man Commodities,** a world leading trader of agricultural products including coffee, sugar, molasses and animal feed.


Volcafe works across the whole green coffee supply chain to make coffee business better, together with our partners and employees. We have built and operate sustainable coffee supply chains across all our origins, addressing key economic, social and environmental issues in coffee farming communities. Our Volcafe Way farmer support programme engages with thousands of coffee farmers and provides a holistic response to the challenges they face.
 

**This role will be working for ED\&F Man Commodities India Private Limited, Volcafe’s company in India.**

* Work across the full coffee supply chain – from origination and contract execution through shipment, inventory, quality, and documentation to settlement.
* Simplify and standardise workflows and documentation so they are more reliable, hand off cleanly across time zones, and can be reused across origins.
* Challenge every recurring manual task, applying automation, analytics, and AI to remove low\-value effort so the team can focus on exceptions and judgement.
* Turn business needs into clear requirements, practical prototypes, and reusable process improvements.
* Build lightweight tools for operational summaries, exception tracking, and reporting that give global teams timely visibility and surface issues early.
* Keep financially sensitive outputs accurate and auditable, using AI for summaries and explanations rather than calculations.
* Train users, gather feedback, and iterate workflows to drive adoption and measurable improvement.
* Give global teams clear daily recaps and operational alerts on what changed during Asia hours.

AI Workflow Design \& Implementation:


* Identify which tasks to automate, which to assist with AI, and which to eliminate – prioritising by ease, effort, and level of pain.
* Design practical AI\-assisted workflows for operational Q\&A, document review, exception triage, and reporting across the lifecycle.
* Use AI to summarise contracts, shipment updates, inventory movements, and origin reports, and to explain what changed and why.
* Keep a person in the loop for anything touching trade, finance, logistics, or external communications, with clear escalation points.
* Ensure calculations, reconciliations, and financially sensitive outputs stay accurate, validated, and auditable.
* Measure impact – effort saved and cycle time – capturing a baseline before each change so improvements are evidenced, not estimated.

What Success Looks Like:


* Coffee moves more smoothly from origin to the end customer, with fewer delays, handoff gaps, and manual touchpoints along the way.
* Physical operations workflows are more standardised, reliable, and less dependent on individuals or spreadsheets.
* Recurring manual tasks are measurably reduced, with effort saved and cycle times improved against a baseline captured before each change.
* Cross\-functional and global teams get faster, clearer, and more reliable operational information.
* Improvements built and deployed are reused across regions and origins rather than rebuilt each time.
* AI and automation are trusted and adopted because they are practical, auditable, and fit how the supply chain actually works.

**Overview**
============


BTVK Advisory is a leading advisory firm whose specialized professionals guide clients through an ever\-changing business world, helping them win now and anticipate tomorrow. BTVK Advisory, and its affiliated entities, have operations in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. BTVK Advisory’s ultimate parent entity, Baker Tilly US, LLP, is an independent member of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion.

  

  

*Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.*

 *To be added to all ET through Experienced requisitions Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.*

**Job Description:**
====================

  

Responsibilities:

* Analyze client tax data to identify opportunities across specialty tax domains, including State \& Local Tax (SALT), R\&D Tax Credits, Cost Segregation, and other specialty tax services.
* Evaluate client facts, financial information, and tax documentation to identify potential tax planning, compliance, and cross\-sell opportunities.
* Translate tax practitioner expertise into structured business rules, signal logic, and decision frameworks for AI\-enabled tax solutions.
* Collaborate with tax subject matter experts (SMEs), product managers, and engineering teams to define, validate, and refine tax signal models.
* Review and interpret data from tax returns, workpapers, trial balances, fixed asset registers, general ledgers, engagement files, CRM systems, and other client documentation.
* Support the design and enhancement of tax data models, ontologies, and AI\-driven workflows by providing domain expertise.
* Document tax signal definitions, validation criteria, confidence levels, business rules, and escalation guidelines to ensure consistency and transparency.
* Maintain high standards of governance and quality by distinguishing verified facts from inferred tax opportunities and ensuring appropriate documentation.
* Research emerging tax regulations, industry trends, and specialty tax developments to enhance opportunity identification and analytical capabilities.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt AI tools and analytical technologies to improve tax analysis, operational efficiency, and business insights.


Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Taxation, Finance, Commerce or related discipline.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in tax consulting, tax compliance, or specialty tax services such as SALT, R\&D Tax Credits, Cost Segregation, or related areas.
* Strong understanding of U.S. tax concepts, client engagement processes, and specialty tax service offerings.
* Experience reviewing and interpreting tax returns, workpapers, financial statements, trial balances, fixed asset schedules, and other financial records.
* Ability to convert tax knowledge into structured business rules, decision logic, and opportunity identification frameworks.
* Working knowledge of data architecture, data modeling, tax data structures, or AI\-enabled business processes, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams.
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex business and tax scenarios.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge discussions between tax professionals, product teams, and data engineers.
* Demonstrated commitment to quality, governance, documentation, and maintaining accuracy in tax analysis and recommendations.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies, particularly AI and automation tools, with the ability to leverage them effectively to improve tax processes and insights.

jobs.description:
**Job Description** 




 The AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) / Smart Meter Business Analyst is responsible for gathering, analysing, and translating business requirements related to smart metering systems including AMI, MDM, HES, Prepaid Billing, WFM, and SLA applications into functional specifications for product and development teams. The role bridges DISCOM stakeholders, AMISP vendors, technical teams, and operations to ensure smooth implementation, integration, and performance of smart meter solutions.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The AMI / Smart Meter Business Analyst is responsible for gathering, analysing, and translating business requirements related to smart metering systems.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Requirements Gathering \& Analysis**
* Engage with DISCOMs, AMISP, and internal teams to capture business requirements for AMI, MDM, Billing, HES, and integration processes.
* Document functional \& non\-functional requirements, business process flows, and user stories.
* Analyse gaps in current vs. expected AMI workflows (installation to billing cycle).



  




* **Integration \& Data Flow Understanding**
* Understand system integration between HES ↔ MDM ↔ Billing ↔ WFM ↔ SLA applications.
* Review API specifications, payload structures, data validation rules, and communication workflows.
* Coordinate with integration teams for new API development and enhancements.



  




* **Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Prepare UAT test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and validation checklists.
* Perform functional testing of AMI/MDM modules, reports, dashboards, and mobile app features.
* Validate AMI data synchronization, meter onboarding, exception handling, and SLA calculations.



  




* **Project Monitoring \& Reporting**
* Monitor project progress, requirement status, change requests, and system performance.
* Ensure timely delivery of AMI modules as per project plan.
* Support MIS reporting, analytical dashboards, and KPI tracking.



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.Tech / B.E Electrical and Electronics or M. Tech with relevant experience.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* **Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of AMI, Smart Metering, MDM, HES, Billing processes.
* Experience with APIs, JSON/XML payloads, SQL basics, and data validation.
* Familiarity with WFM mobile applications and SLA performance systems.



  




* **Business \& Analytical Skills**
* Excellent documentation (BRD/FSD), business analysis, and process mapping skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business\-friendly language.
* Expertise in Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools.



  




* **Soft Skills**
* Strong communication, stakeholder management \& coordination.
* Problem solving, analytical mindset, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work in cross\-functional environments with AMISP \& DISCOM teams.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* 2\-4 years of experience in AMI/MDM/Smart Metering domain.
* Prior work with DISCOM/Utility/AMISP projects preferred.

jobs.description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a
 **Flex Work** 
 approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Lead Business Systems Analyst (Process Automation) is responsible for driving the adoption, delivery, support, and governance of the company’s no\-code and low\-code application development and business process automation platforms. This role serves as the primary bridge between business teams and IT, enabling scalable automation, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring strong governance, security, and value realization across the enterprise automation portfolio. It will partner with the business to use platforms like Microsoft Power Platform as well as RPA, IDP, AI, and other automation technologies to reduce manual processes and improve business outcomes. This role combines solution design with vendor management, training, portfolio governance, and strategic planning to align the right automation technologies with the right business problems.
   

  

 This role will be based in Bangalore, India, and will report to the Senior Manager of Automation \& Governance within our IT Enterprise Applications team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business Engagement: Partner with business stakeholders to understand business processes and identify automation opportunities. Guide them to the appropriate automation technology (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, RPA, Copilot, low\-code apps, traditional pro\-code apps, etc.) to fit their use cases and requirements.
* Requirements Gathering: Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for workflow automation development and AI\-driven automation.
* No\-Code \& Low\-Code Configuration: Conduct hands\-on design and configuration of automations, workflows, and user interfaces using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.), UiPath, AI tools, as well as no\-code solutions such as Smartsheet and Airtable.
* Design \& Development Collaboration: Design solutions that require technical development and collaborate with automation engineers, application developers, and AI engineers to translate business needs into scalable automation solutions.
* Communication \& Training: Lead enterprise\-wide communication, maintain educational materials, conduct live training, and drive adoption of automation tools and platforms. Support and enable citizen development across the organization.
* Align with Other IT Teams: Proactively partner with other IT teams (Infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering Enablement, and Security) to ensure the appropriate automation technologies are leveraged and aligned with business needs.
* Testing: Design and execute quality, performance, and security testing to validate that automation solutions meet business and technical requirements.
* Test Automation \& Testing CoE: Serve as a key team member for our IT Testing Center of Excellence (CoE), working with IT analysts to use our test automation tools to minimize repetitive, manual application testing. Train other IT teams on how to use our test management suite to track test plans and results for their projects.
* Governance: Establish, maintain, and enforce governance for automation and AI tools, including:
+ Maintain an inventory of business\-built applications and automations
+ Track data sources, integrations, and ownership
+ Ensure applications comply with legal, security, and data policies

* Portfolio Management: Document requests for automation initiatives, expected effort, cost, and business benefits, and use this information to prioritize the automation portfolio.
* Vendor Management: Build relationships with our automation and AI platform vendors. Stay current on new product capabilities, future roadmaps, and industry trends.
* Licensing Administration: Manage licensing and user administration of automation platforms and AI tools.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in IT roles serving as a business systems analyst, gathering business requirements and working with technical teams to deliver systems solutions.
* 5\+ years of experience in roles specifically focused on business process automation, API development, and AI tools.
* Deep hands\-on experience configuring Microsoft Power Platform to deliver low\-code business process automation solutions.
* Experience using AI in conjunction with process automation solutions to improve business processes.
* Experience working with technical developers to deliver business automations built on enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, etc.).
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to define the project scope, establish a timeline, coordinate resources, communicate status, and manage the delivery of results.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), testing practices, and IT governance.
* Familiarity with enterprise application landscapes (ERP, CRM, HR, Finance systems).
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence individuals at both technical and executive levels within IT and the business.
* Excellent English written and verbal communication skills,…
